messages:
Elena (support): @Alex customer acct_8GHT reports 0 token change after successful /v1/generate calls. They sent a 200 with usage.tokens=42 but their UI/balance still shows full trial credits. Screenshot attached. Can ops confirm ledger update?

OpsBot: Incident recorded #INC-4321, logs attached. Notifying billing team. :rotating_light:

Jun (eng): Can you paste the raw response + request_id and region? Also what SDK/version? Quick repro curl would help.

Elena (support): Request_id: req_0a9f7bcd. Region: us-west-2. Model: redwood-alpha-1. SDK: js-sdk@2.1.2. Curl used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"Summarize this doc"}'
```
Response body we received: `{"id":"resp_0a9f7bcd","usage":{"tokens":42},"status":"succeeded"}`. Customer says balance still unchanged after multiple refreshes.

Jun (eng): Looking at request_id req_0a9f7bcd in the ingestion logs — service returned 200 and we enqueued a billing event, but I see a downstream delivery error to billing-svc around the same time: `ECONNRESET` to ledger.redwood.internal:443. Forwarding trace to billing.

Sahil (billing): Confirmed: webhook delivery to ledger failed at 2026-02-14T12:34:56Z due to connection reset. We have idempotency keys in place (idempotency_key=req_0a9f7bcd). Will replay the event to ledger and reconcile delta.

Alex (CSM): Customer is on a 500-credit trial and has a demo scheduled tomorrow — needs clear messaging. Please provide ETA on reconciliation and whether any manual credit adjustment is needed.

Sahil (billing): Replayed event to ledger and applied a charge of 42 tokens against acct_8GHT at 2026-02-14T12:40:12Z. UI cache TTL might still show stale value; I flushed the account cache and triggered a websocket update.

Elena (support): Confirmed with customer — balance now shows correctly (they report -42). Customer thanks the team. Closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
